purpose: Define evaluation of an exact Trigger definition against one exact Event/context, producing matched/not-matched/error evidence without itself executing downstream work.

topics.name: Trigger Evaluation
topics.purpose: Define evaluation of an exact Trigger definition against one exact Event/context, producing matched/not-matched/error evidence without itself executing downstream work.

semantics.condition_rule: Trigger conditions are explicit and deterministic under declared profile.
semantics.evidence_rule: Evaluation evidence records relevant fields/refs without hidden mutation.
semantics.execution_rule: Matched result may create a separate invocation/Runner request through explicit binding.
semantics.authority_rule: Trigger match does not grant operation authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: matched trigger executes hidden code directly
